business_problem: Rakuten Securities needed a more human digital way to guide rapidly growing numbers of first-time investors through complex financial products because it operates as an online brokerage without nationwide branches for in-person advice.
solution_summary: Rakuten Securities extended its July 2023 Investment AI Assistant into a richer customer-facing advisory experience by working with Deloitte Japan and NVIDIA on an Investment Consultation AI Avatar. The implementation keeps the client's GenAI assistant as the answer engine, uses NVIDIA Omniverse ACE as the avatar foundation, and places Deloitte's Quartz Frontline AI in front as the conversational interface. Customers can ask basic investment questions, the service generates answers in Japanese text-to-speech, and the avatar returns them with synchronized voice, mouth movement, and gestures to make the exchange feel more human. Rakuten's AI Data & Human Lab led the work so novice investors opening accounts under the new NISA environment could get guidance quickly in a digital-only channel without relying on branch-based interactions.

solution_components.name: Investment AI Assistant

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Omniverse ACE
solution_components.role: Supplies the avatar foundation used to deliver natural-language interaction, speech, and human-like presentation.

solution_components.name: Quartz Frontline AI
solution_components.role: Acts as the next-generation user interface that connects Rakuten Securities' assistant to the avatar experience.

solution_components.name: Investment Consultation AI Avatar
solution_components.role: Packages the assistant into a customer-facing Japanese conversational avatar with synchronized voice, gestures, and lip movement.

data_flow: Customers ask basic investment questions through the Investment Consultation AI Avatar, Rakuten Securities' Investment AI Assistant generates the answer, Quartz Frontline AI presents the experience, and NVIDIA Omniverse ACE returns the response as Japanese speech with synchronized mouth movement and gestures.
business_outcome: Rakuten Securities built and demonstrated the avatar in two months at its 2024 New Year Conference, and more than 90% of customers who tried the demonstration said they would be interested in using it in the future, indicating a more engaging digital experience for novice investors.
metrics: More than 90% of the customers who experienced the Investment Consultant AI Avatar demonstration said they were interested in using it in the future.
architecture_clues: Rakuten Securities AI Data & Human Lab served as the lead organization for solution development.
The avatar adds a Japanese text-to-speech capability plus synchronized lip movement and human-like gestures for conversational delivery.
The implementation extends the July 2023 Investment AI Assistant rather than replacing it with a net-new advisory backend.

source_references.title: Investing in a more authentic customer experience | Deloitte Global

evidence_quotes: In July 2023, Rakuten Securities released the GenAI-enabled "Investment AI Assistant" chat service.

They collaborated on a new system that would build upon the client's Investment AI Assistant, using NVIDIA's Omniverse ACE (Avatar Cloud Engine) as its foundation and Deloitte's Quartz Frontline AI as the next-generation user interface.
A new Japanese Text to Speech (TTS) function enables the avatar to recognize a customer's investment questions and deliver a response.
This is accompanied by human-like gestures from the avatar, as well as synchronized mouth movements and voice to facilitate more-realistic conversation-based communication.
Developed in just two months, the Investment Consultant AI Avatar made its debut on January 14 as part of the Rakuten Securities New Year Conference 2024.
More than 90% of the customers who experienced the Investment Consultant AI Avatar demonstration said they were interested in using it in the future.
